title: Vacuum Dryer

introduction.definition: A rotary double-cone vacuum dryer dries batches of heat-sensitive or solvent-wet powders. The double-cone vessel turns slowly on trunnions, tumbling the product against its heated jacket. A vacuum pump lowers the pressure so the moisture or solvent boils at a low temperature; vapour passes a filter and is condensed.

working_principle.characteristic_curve: Drying curve: constant-rate period then falling-rate period; vacuum level sets product temperature.

pressure.title: Low pressure lowers the boiling point
pressure.description: Under vacuum (e.g. ~ 20–100 mbar abs) water and solvents boil at low temperature (≈ 20–45 °C), so heat-sensitive or solvent-wet products can be dried gently. The slow rotation tumbles the product against the heated wall; vapour is drawn through a filter to a condenser where solvents can be recovered.

foundation: Structure designed for equipment, product and dynamic loads; explosion venting directed to a safe area.
alignment: Align fans, rotary valves and drives; level chambers and beds.
piping: Air/gas ducts with dampers and expansion joints; dust collection (cyclone, bag filter); explosion isolation where required (ATEX/NFPA).
commissioning: Air balance; heat-up curve; water trials then product; check outlet temperature/moisture control and interlocks.

routine.task: Check vacuum level, jacket temperature, seal condition.

lubrication: Drive gearbox oil; trunnion bearings greased.

safety: Flammable solvents: inerting, ATEX electrical equipment; vessel rated for full vacuum.

The double-cone vessel turns slowly on trunnions, tumbling the product against its heated jacket.
A vacuum pump lowers the pressure so the moisture or solvent boils at a low temperature; vapour passes a filter and is condensed.

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Vacuum Dryer.
Check vacuum level, jacket temperature, seal condition.
Clean filter; check condenser.
Replace trunnion seals and bearings.
Watch for vacuum leaks: slow drying. Common cause: seal wear.
Watch for lump formation: uneven drying. Common cause: product stickiness.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
